For minimal covers of size 4 over 4 windows: each window needs a unique witness literal. With 32 random predicates over 4 windows (each true w.p. 0.5), a random 4-subset covers all 4 windows w.p. (1-0.5^4)^4 = 0.9375^4 = 0.78, and minimality requires each literal to be uniquely true on some window — that's likely with 4 windows and 4 literals. So we could get ~20000+ rules. cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import ctypes, json, random, sys, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import numpy as np
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
import netnomos.learners.exact as ex

# instrument node count
orig = ex.ExactDisjunctionLearner.fit
nodes = [0]
def patched(self, train_masks, universe_masks, record_of_bit, universe_size):
    import types
    # count calls to search by wrapping: simple approach - re-implement counter via sys.setprofile is heavy;
    # instead count via monkeypatched recursion using a global counter in a copy of the algorithm
    P=len(train_masks); limit=min(self.width,P); records=len(record_of_bit)
    full=(1<<records)-1
    cnt=[0]
    def search(clause,start,cover):
        if len(clause)>=limit: return
        for pid in range(start,P):
            cnt[0]+=1
            joined=cover|train_masks[pid]
            if joined!=full: search(clause+(pid,),pid+1,joined)
    search((),0,0)
    nodes[0]=cnt[0]
    return orig(self, train_masks, universe_masks, record_of_bit, universe_size)
ex.ExactDisjunctionLearner.fit=patched

# heavy case: 32 predicates, N=10000, U=65536 -> max node count expected
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from stress import make_job
job = make_job([2]*16, 1, 32, 4, 10000, 64, 'random', seed=5)
t=time.time(); res=compile_job(job); dt=time.time()-t
print('no-cover case: nodes=%d time=%.3fs rules=%d' % (nodes[0], dt, len(res['rules'])))

# many-rules worst case: tiny train, many predicates
job = make_job([2]*16, 1, 32, 4, 4, 64, 'random', seed=11)
nodes[0]=0
t=time.time(); res=compile_job(job); dt=time.time()-t
print('small-train case: nodes=%d time=%.3fs rules=%d out=%dKiB' % (nodes[0], dt, len(res['rules']), len(json.dumps(res))//1024))

job = make_job([2]*16, 1, 32, 4, 20, 64, 'random', seed=12)
nodes[0]=0
t=time.time(); res=compile_job(job); dt=time.time()-t
print('N=20 case: nodes=%d time=%.3fs rules=%d out=%dKiB' % (nodes[0], dt, len(res['rules']), len(json.dumps(res))//1024))
PYEOF
